title: Distinct assignments differ at a coordinate
statement: Let $r$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $a,b$ be assignments of signs to the $r$ coordinates. If $a$ and $b$ are distinct, then there is a coordinate $j$ at which their assigned signs differ.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ and $b$ are assignments of signs to the $r$ coordinates
